lessons.title: Probability

explanation_sections.title: Probability
explanation_sections.body:
For equally likely outcomes, P(E) = favourable outcomes ÷ total outcomes. Probability lies between 0
and 1.

questions.prompt: A fair coin is tossed once. Find probability of heads.
A fair die is rolled. Find probability of a number greater than 4.
A bag has 3 red, 5 blue and 2 green balls. Find probability of blue.
For the same bag, find probability of not selecting red.
Why is the probability of an impossible event zero?
